title: Multistationarity and Permanence in MESSI Reaction Networks
exact_target: For MESSI mass-action biochemical systems, characterize when a stoichiometric compatibility class can contain more than one positive steady state with the same conserved quantities, and determine the related permanence and invariant-subspace properties.
